rngInputObservation.cause: The frequent 0x99D7 update mixes in the Z80 refresh register, so identical prior RNG bytes do not imply identical next bytes when executed instruction paths differ.

firstEnemyStateChange.mechanism: The source uses the low three RNG bits to choose signed horizontal velocity, then sets enemy-kind bit 1 only for a positive chosen velocity. The T path selects -48 while no-T/A select +96/+48. This is not a branch on bit 7 of the RNG byte itself.

limits: The first T-specific enemy state difference at frame 156 follows an already-divergent RNG low-three-bit velocity selection, not evidence of a hit. A also shifts RNG and timing but selects a positive velocity like no-T, delaying damage six frames. Whether any later T action hits an enemy, damages it or changes score remains unverified; these runs do not establish a native combat rule.
